    visited = set()

    visited.add(start_pos)
    comp = set()
    
    while queue:
        r, c = queue.popleft()
        comp.add((r, c))
        for dr, dc in [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]:

            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols:
